paragraphs.text: **Measured:** of the three settings, collaborative tuition ran furthest over budget: $796,673 across 7 of 17 years. Private schools ran $510,256 over in their bad years; Lunenburg’s own schools, $258,209.

**Two things sit beside it.** The collaborative line has had almost no slack: $509,178 over on balance across those years, where private ran $1,409,774 under. And a child arriving already in a collaborative is Lunenburg’s from the first day, with no year paid by the old town (our reading of c.71B §5).
**Not shown:** whether either of those caused the overruns, or how many children did. That needs counts the district does not publish: the grid below names them.

**Out-of-district tuition** is what Lunenburg pays when a **Lunenburg child** goes to school outside its own schools: a **private school** or a **collaborative**. A family moving in or out only changes **which town pays**.
